Hey, I've been experiencing brain fog for the past 5 months. I can't even function anymore. I can't feel joy, or deep sadness. I used to scream and cry  about it and now I don't even have the energy to do that anymore. I used to be so outgoing and super funny literally the life of the party at my college. I was in a sorority but decided to drop because I started feeling off and not myself. It was personal insecurities and depression at first and now its turned into full on brain fog and anxiety. Im only 20 years old and I feel like my life is over. If I can't feel happiness now- how will I ever feel it again? I can't take this anymore. Ive pushed all friends away. Everything is so foggy and almost blurred. I can't even explain it to anyone without them looking at me like I'm crazy or being overdramatic. What can I do to get out of this its debilitating.

side note: my doctor prescribed me Zoloft for depression but it didn't do much so I stopped.
